panels: One shared oblique projected salt lattice; no separate subfigures.

species.filled: One ion species, represented by filled black circles. No source label identifies which chemical species.
species.open: The other ion species, represented by outlined white circles. No source label identifies which chemical species.

coordinateMeaning: Approximate centers digitized in the original PNG, x rightward and y downward. Screen coordinates ONLY, not measured three-dimensional coordinates.

finiteStructure.backR1C1: No independently visible marker: the row/column intersection is behind front-r0-c2. Do not add a visible twenty-seventh site.
finiteStructure.projectedRows: Left-to-right slopes differ by depth; front rows slope down toward the right; back top row is nearly horizontal.
finiteStructure.projectedColumns: Near-vertical, with hand-drawn offsets. No numeric orthogonality is given.
finiteStructure.depthRelations: Corresponding front/middle/back sites shift up and right; their screen vectors are not identical and are not calibrated.
finiteStructure.nativeGridDimensionsBlocker: The existing renderer and validator support only axis-aligned regular grid objects. A visible native grid would replace or overlay this oblique, unequal screen-space structure. No invisible or opacity-zero surrogate grid is acceptable.

edgeInventoryRule.rowChains: For each layer and row, connect successive visible column sites. Back row 1 is a single source line between c0 and c2, passing behind the foreground filled site.
edgeInventoryRule.columnChains: For each layer and column, connect successive visible row sites. Back column 1 is an unsplit source line from row 0 to row 2, largely occluded by foreground geometry.
edgeInventoryRule.depthChains: For each row and column, connect front to middle and middle to back. Middle-r1-c1 has a visible ascending-right continuation that disappears into the foreground occluder; its terminal pixel [288,133] is an unmarked hidden stroke endpoint, not a source site.
edgeInventoryRule.backLeftColumn: Both parts of the back c0 vertical line are dashed; retain dashes.
edgeInventoryRule.remainingLines: Remaining source lattice connectors are solid; far-back horizontal connectors are thinner than front edges.
edgeInventoryRule.meaning: The rods connect depicted equilibrium-position sites and show the spatial lattice; do not call these salt rods discrete covalent bonds.

firstSourceObservations: All 26 visible marker centers, both marker appearances, and three-depth-layer projection recorded before authoring.
A source circle's small white highlight is not an additional ion species or a label.
Several rods disappear behind filled or open markers; shared projection must retain these crossings, not expand into independent panels.
No axes, tick marks, right-angle markers, dimension labels, chemical labels, arrows, or calibration appear.
allowedModernAdditions: English title identifying table salt as an ionic crystal, grounded in approved bilingual text.
Neutral legend for the two source marker appearances, without guessing which is sodium or chloride.
Projected arrangement label; no numerical lengths or angles.
authorDisposition: HOLD until the mandatory finite-row/column assertion can be represented without altering the source projection.
